# `allocation-after-init`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: disciplined · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports direct allocation in a function outside recognized `init*` and `create*`
paths.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Projects that allocate at startup make out-of-memory a bounded initialization
failure instead of an arbitrary runtime failure.

## When it fires

Only allocator-typed or allocator-named direct receivers are reported;
unresolved transitive calls are silent.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn grow(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8 {
    return try gpa.alloc(u8, 16);
}
```
